Slogans for freedom: The Daily Star celebrates 50 years of Independence
2021-03-29T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/lifestyle/news/slogans-freedom-the-daily-star-celebrates-50-years-independence-2068305

On the occasion of the golden jubilee of Bangladesh's independence, The Daily Star presents a theatrical, audio-visual production featuring slogans that were chanted during various movements up to the Liberation War.

Produced by Star Lifestyle, the video is now available on The Daily Star's digital platform. The audio-visual production has been directed by Goutam Koiri, and sponsored by Tradesworth Household Limited.
